blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — North Maharlika Energy Corp. is earmarking about P3 billion to build a waste-to-energy (WTE) power plant in Pangasinan. In a document submitted to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources, the company has proposed developing a 12-megawatt (MW) facility, offering new baseload power generation that can run for 25 years.
